## In this session

Presentations by students completing the **Master Minor** and the **Master Major**.

For Major students this is an explicit **test run for the defence**: the same format, the same
kind of questions, without the consequences.

## Format

| | Master Minor | Master Major |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Presentation | Project work (*Projektarbeit*) | MA thesis |
| Length | To be confirmed | To be confirmed |
| Setting | Presentation and discussion | Defence rehearsal, with questions from the panel |

::: {.callout-note title="Timings to be confirmed"}
Exact durations and the running order are fixed during the semester, in the final-year meetings
in [Session 3](/contents/sessions/03.qmd) and [Session 8](/contents/sessions/08.qmd).
:::

## What to prepare

-   The **research question** and why it is worth asking
-   **Sources and data**: what you have, how you got it, what its limits are
-   **Method**: what you did, and why that rather than something else
-   **Results**, including the ones that did not fit
-   **Limitations** — anticipate the objection and make it yourself first
-   **Reproducibility**: where the data and the code are

## For everyone else

Attendance is expected even if you are not presenting. Watching a defence rehearsal a year or two
before your own is the cheapest preparation available, and the questions asked of others are the
questions you will be asked.

## Closing the semester

-   Where the Lab goes next
-   Colloquia, projects and assistantships at DH Bern
